passages.scripture: Therefore, since Christ suffered in His body, arm yourselves with the same resolve, because anyone who has suffered in his body is done with sin.

lines.text: Christ suffered in His body.
So arm yourselves with the same resolve.
For anyone who has suffered in the body is done with sin.

passages.scripture: Consequently, he does not live out his remaining time on earth for human passions, but for the will of God.

lines.text: So those who have suffered in the body no longer live their remaining life on earth for human passions — strong sinful desires.
Instead, those who have suffered in the body live for the will of God.

passages.scripture: For you have spent enough time in the past carrying out the same desires as the Gentiles: living in debauchery, lust, drunkenness, orgies, carousing, and detestable idolatry.

lines.text: You once chased the same desires as the Gentiles.
You lived in debauchery and lust — shameless, sinful pleasure.
You gave in to drunkenness and wild parties.
And you worshiped detestable idols.
Sinful living like this is the old way you used to live.
For you have already spent enough time living this way.

passages.scripture: Because of this, they consider it strange of you not to plunge with them into the same flood of reckless indiscretion, and they heap abuse on you.

lines.text: You no longer plunge with the Gentiles into the same flood of reckless, wild living.
These Gentiles think it strange of you to stop sinning with them.
And so these Gentiles heap abuse on you.

passages.scripture: But they will have to give an account to Him who is ready to judge the living and the dead.

lines.text: But the Gentiles will give an account to God.
God is ready to judge.
God will judge everyone who is alive.
And God will judge everyone who has died.

passages.scripture: That is why the gospel was preached even to those who are now dead, so that they might be judged as men in the flesh, but live according to God in the spirit.

lines.text: This is why the gospel was preached even to those who are now dead.
In the flesh they were judged, in a human way.
But now they live with God in the spirit.

passages.scripture: The end of all things is near. Therefore be clear-minded and sober, so that you can pray.

lines.text: The end of all things is near.
So be clear-minded.
And be sober.
So that you can pray.

passages.scripture: Above all, love one another deeply, because love covers over a multitude of sins.

lines.text: Love covers over a multitude of sins — love forgives and overlooks many wrongs.
Therefore, above all, love.
Love one another.
And love deeply.

passages.scripture: Show hospitality to one another without complaining.

lines.text: Show hospitality to one another — welcome each other into your homes.
And do it without complaining.

passages.scripture: As good stewards of the manifold grace of God, each of you should use whatever gift he has received to serve one another.

lines.text: Each of you has received a gift from God.
Use your gift to serve one another.
In this way you are good stewards — trusted managers — of God's grace in all its many forms.

passages.scripture: If anyone speaks, he should speak as one conveying the words of God. If anyone serves, he should serve with the strength God provides, so that in all things God may be glorified through Jesus Christ, to whom be the glory and the power forever and ever. Amen.

lines.text: If anyone has the gift of speaking, he should speak as one who delivers the very words of God.
If anyone has the gift of serving, he should serve with the strength God provides.
So that in everything, God may be glorified through Jesus Christ.
To Him be the glory and the power forever and ever.
Amen — so be it.

passages.scripture: Beloved, do not be surprised at the fiery trial that has come upon you, as though something strange were happening to you.

lines.text: Beloved, do not be surprised at the fiery trial that has come upon you — it tests your faith like fire.
Do not think the fiery trial is something strange happening to you.
Be prepared, for a fiery trial will come upon you.

passages.scripture: But rejoice that you share in the sufferings of Christ, so that you may be overjoyed at the revelation of His glory.

lines.text: You share in the sufferings of Christ through your fiery trial.
If you share in His sufferings now, you will also share in His glory.
Your suffering with Christ is light and momentary, but later it brings an eternal weight of glory.
So rejoice that you share in the sufferings of Christ!
And you will be overjoyed when His glory is revealed.

passages.scripture: If you are insulted for the name of Christ, you are blessed, because the Spirit of glory and of God rests on you.

lines.text: If people insult you for the name of Christ — if they mistreat you because you belong to Him — you are blessed.
For the Spirit of glory — the Spirit of God — rests on you.

passages.scripture: Indeed, none of you should suffer as a murderer or thief or wrongdoer, or even as a meddler.

lines.text: None of you should suffer because of your own sin:
not as a murderer, a thief, or an evildoer,
or even as a meddler — someone who interferes in other people's business.

passages.scripture: But if you suffer as a Christian, do not be ashamed, but glorify God that you bear that name.

lines.text: But if you suffer because you are a Christian — a follower of Christ — do not be ashamed.
Instead, glorify God that you bear the name of Christ.

passages.scripture: For it is time for judgment to begin with the family of God; and if it begins with us, what will the outcome be for those who disobey the gospel of God?

lines.text: For the time has come for God's judgment to begin with His own family.
This judgment begins with us, the people of God.
So what will the end be for those who reject the gospel of God — His good news?

passages.scripture: And, “If it is hard for the righteous to be saved, what will become of the ungodly and the sinner?”

lines.text: Even the righteous are saved only with great difficulty.
So what will become of the ungodly and the sinner — those who reject God?

passages.scripture: So then, those who suffer according to God’s will should entrust their souls to their faithful Creator and continue to do good.

lines.text: So if you suffer according to God's will, entrust your very soul to God.
He is your faithful Creator — He made you and always keeps His word.
And keep doing good, even in the middle of your suffering.
